name: Ad Daarr
description: Hardship and harm cannot occur outside Allah's authority; He decrees with knowledge and justice.
summary: Ad Daarr is understood alongside An Naafi', relating hardship and benefit to Allah's authority. Quran 6:17 and 10:107 describe His power over harm and good. The Arabic root is ض ر ر; the explanation does not attribute injustice or aimless harm to Allah.
